costHints.note: Depends on surface-swift (composes under its area-3 '/Newsletter Emails' subtree and reuses its Swift-v2_Email* item types + the shipped Unsubscribe confirmation page). The layer.schema.json has no formal 'depends' field; the dependency is documented here (advisory) and enforced by edition composition order (surface before feature). Data-only: no customCode/src.
costHints.minSerializerVersionNote: Advisory, not a second floor: the enforced floor is base.contract.json compat.apps[id=Truvio.Commerce.Serializer].min, which is 1.0.6-beta, and this value may never sit below it. What this layer itself needs: the three EmailMarketingEmail rows (1.0.5) carry integer page ids in EmailPageId / EmailUnsubscribePageId, which only Serializer 1.0.4-beta and later resolve through the page map and bind by the pageRefs PageUniqueId (Serializer #27); an older engine writes the source page ids verbatim and every email points at the wrong page or none. Harvested and proven on 1.0.6-beta.
